newsitem.title: ITALY: MOTOR RACING-FERRARI SIGN DEAL WITH BARNARD.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-FERRARI SIGN DEAL WITH BARNARD.

text.p: Formula One designer John Barnard has signed an agreement with Ferrari to take over the design and development company they set up together, the Italian motor racing team said in a statement on Thursday.
Barnard signed a five-year contract with Ferrari in 1992, working from Ferrari Design and Development based in Guildford, England.
"A final agreement (was) signed yesterday between Ferrari and John Barnard to conclude the arrangements for the transfer of its English facilities," the Ferrari statement said.
It said the company would now be known as B3 Technologies Ltd and operate "totally autonomously in respect of Ferrari." The statement did not reveal financial terms of the deal.
Barnard, 50, introduced semi-automatic transmissions to Ferrari in the late 1980s -- a design which became universal in Formula One cars -- before moving to Benetton for a spell.
